Says whether an image is completely loaded, without waiting for it. With [AsyncLoading](AsyncLoading) on, [LoadImage](LoadImage) returns while the picture is still being decoded on another thread, and this is 1 once that is done and the image is on the graphics card. Without asynchronous loading every image is ready as soon as [LoadImage](LoadImage) returns, so this is always 1. Drawing the image, [ImageWidth](ImageWidth), [ImageBuffer](ImageBuffer) and the like never need this call: they wait for the loading by themselves.

This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no asynchronous loading.
@param image  The image to ask about.
@returns 1 if the image is loaded, and 0 if it is still loading or does not exist.
